item.title: Baqaei: Disruption in operation of Iran-Pakistan border crossings is temporary
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei announced a temporary suspension of cross-border movement between Iran and Pakistan due to technical issues, saying that the two countries are in consultations to resolve the problem and restore normal operations at the border crossings.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86295416/Baqaei-Disruption-in-operation-of-Iran-Pakistan-border-crossings

Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei announced a temporary suspension of cross-border movement between Iran and Pakistan due to technical issues, saying that the two countries are in consultations to resolve the problem and restore normal operations at the border crossings.
